description: How the original game numbered its things, for the parts that need the original numbers: the game's save record and the saves of the original (version 1 save files, PS1 memory cards). Everything else, mods included, uses the names. "items" and "weapons": the original item and weapon numbers in groups of 32 (the k-th group starts at 32 * k; null is an unused number), names of gamedata/items and gamedata/weapons. "characters": the original character numbers from 0 (names of gamedata/chara). "common_pickups": the pickups the map events give by number. "event_flags": the original save layout of the event flags: the n-th name (from 1) is save bit n; the flags themselves and their descriptions are declared in gamedata/flags/*.json, and a flag that is not listed here (a mod's) gets a free bit when the game loads. Never reorder or remove an entry: an old save would load into other things. A mod does not edit this file; its new items, characters and flags get free numbers at load.
